title: Mounted secrets fail in --read-only containers with crun 1.31
body:
### Issue Description

After upgrading crun 1.30.1 to crun 1.31, rootless containers combining a read-only root filesystem with a mounted Podman secret fail during container creation.

The minimal failing combination is simply:

- `--read-only`
- a mounted `--secret`

Environment-type secrets are unaffected.

I tested the same command with the same Podman installation and image while selecting different crun binaries:

- crun 1.30.1: succeeds
- crun 1.31: fails with exit status 127

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. Create a disposable secret:

   ```bash
   printf x | podman secret create test -
   ```

2. Run a read-only container with the mounted secret:

   ```bash
   podman run --rm --read-only --secret test registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora-minimal:45 /bin/true
   ```

### Describe the results you received

Container creation fails before `/bin/true` is executed:

```text
Error: crun: open `/home/<user>/.local/share/containers/storage/overlay/<id>/merged/run/secrets/test`: No such file or directory: OCI runtime attempted to invoke a command that was not found
```

### Describe the results you expected

The secret should be mounted at `/run/secrets/test`, `/bin/true` should execute, and the container should exit successfully.

Mounted secrets and read-only root filesystems are independently documented Podman features and worked together with crun 1.30.1.
